subject: general
question: Which of the following ports is known as ‘Diamond Harbour’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diamond Harbour

 
 
• It is a city and a municipality of the 24th South Pargana district in West Bengal.
 
• It is situated on the eastern banks of the Hoogly river. Hence option 3 is correct.
 
• Diamond Harbour in West Bengal located at the mouth of river Hooghly has recorded the maximum sea-level increase, according to data tabled in the Lok Sabha by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Sea ports of India
 
• Chennai seaport: It is an artificial port and also the second busiest port in India.
 
• Kochi seaport: It is located in the Vembanad lake, Kerala, and is important for exports of spices and salts.
 
• Ennor seaport: It is located in Tamil Nadu. It is India’s first corporate port.
 
• Haldia seaport: It is a riverine port Situated on the Hugli river in West Bengal. It is known as Diamond Harbour.
 
• Paradip seaport: It is a Natural port located in Odisha. It deals with the export of iron and aluminium.
